newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nobel literature prize to be revealed on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Nobel literature prize to be revealed on Thursday.

text.p: The winner of the 1996 Nobel Literature Prize, the world's most coveted award for writers, is to be revealed on Thursday, the Swedish Academy said on Tuesday.
"It will be on Thursday at 13.00 (1100 GMT)," a spokeswoman for the academy told Reuters.

The 18-member Swedish Academy announces the prize, this year worth 7.4 million crowns ($1.12 million), on a Thursday, usually in October, whenever the learned academicians have reached their decision.
In keeping with tradition, the winner's identity is to be revealed at the Swedish Academy's meeting place in the stock exchange in Stockholm's mediaeval Old Town.
The 1995 literature prize went to Irish poet Seamus Heaney.
The other Nobel prize-winners for 1996 are to be announced next week.
The Nobel Assembly at the Karolinska Institute will reveal the winner of the medicine prize at 11.00 local time (0900 GMT) in Stockholm on October 7.

The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences will announce the winners of the economics prize on October 8 at 11.30 (0930 GMT) and of the physics and chemistry prizes at 11.45 (0945 GMT) and 14.00 (1200 GMT) respectively at the earliest.
The Nobel Peace Prize will be announced in Oslo on October 11 at 11.00 (0900 GMT). ($1 = 6.6282 crowns)
